title: Targeted In-Context Poisoning of Tabular Foundation Models: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.28396v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict the label of a query row conditioned on a context of labelled rows, without training on them. Drawn from operational data, the context becomes an attack surface. We study targeted in-context poisoning in its simplest form: an attacker with write access to the context's source places exact copies of a target row there with the wrong label. On 30 OpenML datasets for binary classification, one such poison row flips on average 53% (TabICL) and 65% (TabPFN) of the predictions correct without attack, and three poison rows flip almost all. The same copy with the true label flips almost none, and performance on the remaining rows hardly changes. Predictions flip by two routes: in TabICL, the target row's embedding rotates towards the mean of the wrong class; in TabPFN, the poison row pulls genuine rows of the wrong class along. The TFMs thus infer soundly, but from forged evidence. Predictions of traine

translated_title: 表格基础模型的定向上下文投毒：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）以带标签行组成的上下文为条件来预测查询行的标签，而无需在上下文上进行训练。由于上下文来源于运营数据，它便成为了一个攻击面。我们研究了最简单形式的定向上下文投毒：拥有上下文数据源写入权限的攻击者，将目标行的精确副本连同错误标签放入上下文中。在30个OpenML二分类数据集上，仅一条这样的投毒行平均就能翻转53%（TabICL）和65%（TabPFN）原本预测正确的样本，三条投毒行几乎能翻转全部预测。附带真实标签的相同副本则几乎不引起翻转，且对剩余行的性能几乎没有影响。预测通过两条途径被翻转：在TabICL中，目标行的嵌入向错误类别的均值旋转；在TabPFN中，投毒行牵引错误类别的真实行一同移动。由此可见，这些基础模型的推理本身是可靠的，但其依据却是伪造的证据。
tldr: 该实证研究揭示了一种针对表格基础模型的新型攻击：攻击者只需在上下文中放入一条带错误标签的目标行副本，即可定向操控模型对特定样本的预测，一条投毒行平均可翻转53%-65%原本正确的预测结果。
en_tdlr: This empirical study reveals a targeted attack on tabular foundation models: by placing just one copy of a target row with a wrong label into the context, an attacker can flip 53-65% of previously correct predictions on average, exposing in-context learning as a critical attack surface.
